english_policy.waiver_notes: Exemption is at McMaster's discretion (not automatic): four or more years of full-time (non-ESL) study immediately before the start at an accredited secondary school or college in an English-speaking country or at an accredited English-medium school; one year at an accredited English-medium university; or four years' residence in an English-speaking country. Students on GCE, IB or AP curricula may be considered for a waiver with high grades in acceptable courses. Canadian citizenship or a Grade 12 English credit alone is not enough.

english.notes: IELTS Academic or Academic UKVI; 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening; valid 2 years. IELTS One Skill Retake accepted. IELTS organization ID 114599.
Old 0-120 scale, tests completed before 21 Jan 2026: 86 overall with at least 20 in each component. Home Edition accepted; TOEFL Essentials and MyBest not accepted. Institution code 0936.
New 1-6 scale, tests completed on or after 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in Reading, Writing and Speaking and 4.5 in Listening; valid 2 years.
PTE Academic: 60 overall with at least 60 in Writing and Speaking; valid 2 years.
Duolingo English Test: 120 overall for direct-entry undergraduate programs with at least 115 in Reading, 125 in Writing, 110 in Listening and 115 in Speaking.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: 180 overall with at least 176 in each component; valid 2 years.
